{"notes":"2026-11-13 results (Haven 07ce96f = dev1/self-leave-by-reference 5244a53, same tree; dev2/mimi-07 and dev2/mimid-fixes fully merged; mimid worktree interop-07, uncommitted).
A2 (mimid encodes, Haven decodes): harness pinned to 07ce96f + openmls git rev 28369d5b (Haven's pin), tls_codec 0.5; built with no API breakage; expectations updated (partialSuccess now KeyMaterialResponse::Clients, commit bundle now decoded bare). 25/25 clean (decode, fields, byte-identical re-encode), incl. consent_grant / keyMaterial success with mimid's GREASE KeyPackage, partialSuccess with 2 clients, commit bundle with bare Welcome + bare GroupInfo. DIAG: the old 2c14e62 bundle shape is now refused.
A1 (Haven encodes, mimid decodes): generator pinned to 07ce96f; regenerated in place: 18 of 19 old fixtures byte-identical, handshake_bundle_commit changed (prefix gone); 5 new (consent_cancel, consent_revoke, key_material_response_partial_success, key_material_response_no_compatible_exhausted, update_room_response_invalid_proposal). haven_fixtures.rs: 13 tests pass; 23/24 fixtures decode+match+re-encode; key_material_response_exhausted still refused (DIV-13, .46.1.7). PROVENANCE updated with SHA-256.
B4 live vs local mimi-hubd 07ce96f (harness client cert now names b.example; without it every wire request was 403 from Haven's From check): directory ok (groupInfo NotOffered); keyMaterial: Haven KP success+verifies, exhausted -> mimid refuses (.46.1.7), mimid-minted KP success+verifies, no consent -> NoConsent; submitMessage Accepted (stored bytes identical) / non-participant NotAllowed; update: AppDataUpdate alone success, Add+AppDataUpdate success (carol joined from the Welcome), two AppDataUpdates invalidProposal (.46.6.4), leave (AppDataUpdate only) success/held, Commit omitting it invalidProposal naming the ProposalRef (independently verified), Commit by reference + Remove success, replay invalidProposal (.46.6.6); hub list ends [alice, dave], epoch 3; notify own room 201, duplicate 201, Haven's room 403 (correct, §5.5 L2100-2104); requestConsent request/cancel 202 (cancel not processed: .46.6.1), grant on requestConsent 422; updateConsent grant (mimid KP)/revoke 202, request 422; identifierQuery 200-empty / 404 (.46.6.3); reportAbuse 201 -> mimid Rejected (.46.6.2). Content-Type: mimi-hubd accepts mimid's application/mimi-protocol (it does not check request types at all; octet-stream also accepted) and labels its wire bodies application/mimi-protocol. Consent 202/422 interoperate both ways.
mimid-side gap: .46.6.5 (no Remove proposal for self-leave).
Public hub (GET directory only): same keys and values as local 07ce96f except base URL https://mimi.havenmessenger.com:8443 and provider; its DIV-10 text is the b5bf70f wording, so the deployed hub is at least b5bf70f (has the leave lane). Missing -07 keys groupInfo, proxyDownload; extra non-standard keys endpoints, wireEndpoints, mls_ciphersuites, protocol_drafts, provider, unsupported.
Previous Haven beads verified fixed at 07ce96f (notes added): .46.1.8, .11, .12, .13, .14, .15. Logs: session scratchpad b4-run1.log, a2.log."}
